stages.title: Read the command
stages.body: Identify literal, inference, tone, purpose, reference, context meaning or multipart demand.

stages.title: Map the passage
stages.body: Mark thesis, reasons, examples, contrasts, qualifications and conclusion.

stages.title: Locate support
stages.body: Tie each answer to explicit words or a minimally extended inference.

stages.title: Control scope
stages.body: Reject outside knowledge, overstatement, reversal and half-true options.

stages.title: Answer multipart questions
stages.body: List every limb and allocate space before drafting.

stages.title: Calibrate tone and purpose
stages.body: Name stance and function, then support both.

stages.title: Précis ratio
stages.body: Calculate the instructed target and recount after revision.

stages.title: Idea-unit selection
stages.body: Keep thesis, major reasons, concessions and verdict; remove illustration and repetition.

stages.title: Paraphrase
stages.body: Change structure and wording without changing technical meaning.

stages.title: Coherence and indirect style
stages.body: Connect idea units as independent prose and convert quoted claims where needed.

stages.title: Title instruction
stages.body: Obey give-title, no-title or no-suggest-title wording literally.

stages.title: Final fidelity audit
stages.body: Check coverage, compression, independence, coherence, correctness and zero added opinion.
